acceptance_criteria.description: One canonical guide is complete and contains actionable human/agent workflows for issues, PRs, branches, data, experiment bundles, execution, verification, ledger, and handoff.
Redundant operational documents are removed or explicitly classified as protocol/data artifacts; no stale entrypoint points to deleted guidance.
Documentation paths, review-policy tests, collaboration validation, and git diff check pass.

objective: Replace duplicated operational prose with one canonical MagentaBench operating guide covering GitHub collaboration, branches, data, experiments, execution, evidence, and handoff.
title: Unify contributor and experiment operating documentation
